description: This is a Java test source file for the CohortValidator class in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests for cohort validation logic.

classes.name: CohortValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the CohortValidator's validation logic in OpenMRS.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, setting up CohortValidator, loading dataset, and preparing test objects.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenNull
methods.description: Tests that validator.validate throws an IllegalArgumentException when passed null.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenInstanceOfOtherClassThanCohort
methods.description: Tests that validator.validate throws an IllegalArgumentException when passed an object that is not a Cohort.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientIsVoided
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the patient in the cohort is marked as voided.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfPatientIsNonVoided
methods.description: Tests successful validation when patient is not voided.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfMembershipisVoided
methods.description: Tests validation passes when the cohort membership is marked voided.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfPatientAndMembershipAreVoided
methods.description: Tests validation passes when both patient and membership are voided.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfMembershipStartDateIsAfterEndDate
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when start date of membership is after the end date.
